dmn-modeler.js is a combined, pre-built bundle (global: window.AtlasDmn) of:

  - dmn-js@17.10.0              (the DRD / decision-table / literal-expression Modeler)
  - dmn-js-properties-panel@3.11.1
  - @bpmn-io/properties-panel@3.48.0
  - camunda-dmn-moddle@1.3.1    (the camunda: DMN moddle descriptor, for versionTag et al.)

All bpmn.io / MIT (see LICENSE). It used to be the stock dmn-js UMD tarball
(window.DmnJS), but the properties panel and the Modeler must share ONE dmn-js
instance, which a drop-in UMD can't provide — so we bundle them together. The
build is done offline and only its OUTPUT is committed, exactly like the stock
UMD bundle was; nothing is built during Atlas's own build/CI (ADR-0012/0062:
no CDN, no build step at runtime).

window.AtlasDmn exposes: DmnJS (the Modeler), DmnPropertiesPanelModule,
DmnPropertiesProviderModule, CamundaPropertiesProviderModule, CamundaModdleDescriptor.

Do not edit dmn-modeler.js by hand. To rebuild (reproducible, offline):

  npm i dmn-js@17.10.0 dmn-js-properties-panel@3.11.1 \
        @bpmn-io/properties-panel@3.48.0 camunda-dmn-moddle@1.3.1 esbuild@0.24.0
  # src/index.js:
  #   import Modeler from 'dmn-js/lib/Modeler';
  #   import { DmnPropertiesPanelModule, DmnPropertiesProviderModule,
  #            CamundaPropertiesProviderModule } from 'dmn-js-properties-panel';
  #   import CamundaModdleDescriptor from 'camunda-dmn-moddle/resources/camunda.json';
  #   export { Modeler as DmnJS, DmnPropertiesPanelModule, DmnPropertiesProviderModule,
  #            CamundaPropertiesProviderModule, CamundaModdleDescriptor };
  esbuild src/index.js --bundle --format=iife --global-name=AtlasDmn \
        --loader:.json=json --minify --legal-comments=none --outfile=dmn-modeler.js

  # CSS: cp node_modules/@bpmn-io/properties-panel/dist/assets/properties-panel.css assets/

assets/ also holds the dmn-js diagram/drd/decision-table/literal-expression CSS
and the dmn icon font, copied from dmn-js@17.10.0/dist/assets.
